text:
Mike H: noticed a regression on the kernel routing experiment when the runtime switches kernels mid-batch — tokens/sec dropped ~10-13% on our g5 runs
Anya P: which switch specifically? flashB -> paged or fused->flash?
Mike H: flashB -> paged fallback. repro on prod trace shows throughput drop and lots of small cuda stalls
Kevin L: can you paste the bench command and numbers? want to repro locally
Mike H: repro (g5-16)
./bench --model=gptx-30b-q --policy=adaptive:thresh=0.55 --trace=20260310-noisy.json --batcher=continuous
# baseline (fixed:flashB): tokens/sec=6400 p95=185ms kv_hit=0.77
# with adaptive flips: tokens/sec=5580 p95=210ms kv_hit=0.52
Anya P: that's ~12.8% drop in tokens/sec. do we see extra micro-batching or rebind cost?
Kevin L: I captured a flamegraph (infra-bot attached): big time in memcpy+cudaLaunch waits during the rebind path; also scheduler waits for kernel module load and kv-index reattach
infra-bot: perf job 1755554321-attach complete - https://internal/bench/1755554321/flamegraph
Rachel (eng): also seeing batcher stalls: when kernel changes, inflight batches get partially drained then the batcher pauses waiting for kernel init -> creates micro-batches and reduces throughput
Anya P: cost impact calc? give me $/M tokens delta so we can quantify for customers
Kevin L: quick calc using $3.6/hr for g5-16:
- baseline: 6400 t/s -> 23.04M tokens/hr -> $/M = 3.6 / 23.04 =~ $0.156
- adaptive flips: 5580 t/s -> 20.088M tokens/hr -> $/M = 3.6 / 20.088 =~ $0.179
delta ~= +$0.023 per M (~14.7% worse)
Mike H: that scales. at 200M tokens/day that's +$4.6/day for a single customer if they hit the noisy regime
Rachel (eng): quick mitigation ideas:
- increase routing hysteresis window
- require batches_in_flight==0 before rebind
- smooth KV hit rate with EMA to avoid noise-triggered flips
Anya P: agree. also add per-request KV-hit tag to logs so we can correlate individual requests -> kernel choice
Kevin L: pushed a local patch that gates switch until batches drain. small change shows tokens/sec ~6300 on replay (within ~1.5% baseline). diff:
--- a/scheduler.cc
+++ b/scheduler.cc
@@
- if (should_switch()) do_switch();
+ if (should_switch() && inflight_batches==0) do_switch();

Kevin L: starting a 24h noisy-replay with the gate + EMA smoothing. will post summary when done
infra-bot: long replay job 1755554321-2 started
Rachel (eng): config proposal for hotfix:
kernel_routing:
  hysteresis_s: 15  # up from 5
  min_switch_interval_s: 45
  kv_hit_ema_alpha: 0.15
  require_drain_before_switch: true
Anya P: +1 to that. I'll file a tracing ticket to add KV-hit tag: RT-3579
Kevin L: long replay finished - summary: median tokens/sec=6260, no flip churn, KV-hit stddev down 40%, tail latency unchanged
Mike H: looks good. Rachel please coordinate config rollout to staging then prod, Kevin to keep the patch in a short-lived branch until we verify metrics for 72h
Rachel (eng): will do. will also add dashboard widget for kernel_switch_count and microbatch_rate
Mike H: thanks. closing here but monitoring cost dashboard for next 72h :eyes:
